36 घंटे। पानी की एक बूँद भी नहीं। 🌅

Chhath is the festival where the setting sun is worshipped too. Knee-deep in rivers across Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern UP and far beyond, devotees offer arghya at sunset on Sunday and again at sunrise on Monday, after a fast without even water.

Today is Kharna. Tomorrow evening is Sandhya Arghya. 🙏

Send this to someone keeping the Chhath fast this year 💛
Where are you celebrating from? 👇

(chhath puja 2026, chhath puja, sandhya arghya, usha arghya, chhathi maiya, bihar festival)
